entries.title: PostReady: PR #819 — Wire carousel props into pack publish surface (#695/#696)
entries.description: Carousel data (slide count, captions, images) now flows fully into the Post Packs publish surface, completing the end-to-end carousel → publish pipeline.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #817 — Manual download-all-cards + copy-caption fallback for carousels (#696)
entries.description: Added a download-all-cards action for carousels and a copy-caption fallback so users can always get their carousel content even when direct publishing is pending platform API approval.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #816 — Onboarding pivot: business category drives content suggestions (#707)
entries.description: Onboarding now uses the selected business category to drive post and content suggestions, giving new users more relevant starting ideas immediately after sign-up.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #818 — D5: "Add Photo" (editable canvas) vs "Upload Finished Card" (as-is) (#682)
entries.description: Added two distinct card-addition flows in Carousel Creator: "Add Photo" opens the editable canvas for styled slides; "Upload Finished Card" accepts finished artwork as-is for direct use.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #811 — Motion Post explicit preview→publish path (#699)
entries.description: Motion Post flow now has a clear explicit preview→publish path, giving users a final review step before their Motion Post is submitted for publishing.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #812 — Unit tests for carousel platform-limit and Bring-to-Life logic (#710)
entries.description: Added unit test coverage for carousel platform-limit enforcement and Bring to Life generation logic — catches regressions as features evolve.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #813 — I2: purge stale AI-video copy from FAQ/signup, add carousel + Motion Post guidance (#708)
entries.description: Removed outdated AI-video references from FAQ and signup screens. Added fresh guidance for Carousel Creator and Motion Post features in their place.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #815 — Over-limit carousel resolution UX — never silently truncate (#695)
entries.description: Added explicit UX for when a carousel exceeds per-platform slide limits — user is prompted to resolve rather than having slides silently dropped.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #814 — Carousel template library (E5, #691)
entries.description: Added a carousel template library — curated starter templates for common carousel formats, helping users kick off carousel creation without starting from scratch.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #810 — Rewrite trial/subscription copy for no-video, one-plan reality (#706)
entries.description: Copy rewrite across all trial and subscription messaging to reflect the no-video, single-plan reality ($39.97/mo). Completes the full one-plan copy consolidation after H2+H5 pricing changes.
